domain: Football (Soccer) Match and Player Performance Analytics
scenario:
A global sports analytics company is developing an enterprise-level platform to analyze and visualize football (soccer) match and player performance data. This platform is designed to serve teams, analysts, and scouts by providing comprehensive, real-time insights into player performances, team strategies, and match outcomes.

The system should collect data from various football leagues and tournaments worldwide, storing detailed match statistics, player attributes, and team performance metrics. Key features of the platform include tracking expected goals (xG), assists, shots, key passes, goals scored, and positions played. The platform should also support the analysis of player contributions to successful plays (xG chain, xG buildup) and track player involvement in defensive or offensive activities.

The platform must provide advanced data visualization tools to highlight trends, compare player performances over seasons, and assess team tactics. It should support complex queries and reports, allowing users to filter data by player, team, match, season, and various performance metrics.

Additionally, the system should include robust user management to define access levels for different roles, such as administrators, analysts, and team managers, ensuring data security and privacy. The platform should facilitate collaboration among various stakeholders and enable integration with external data sources and analysis tools.
